result.stdout:
kotoha-filter-lsp: relays the Kotoha filter language server to standard input and output.

Options:
  --url <url>            ws(s):// URL of the endpoint, or Shoko's http(s):// base URL
                         (default: $KOTOHA_FILTER_LSP_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:8111)
  --api-key-file <path>  a file holding the API key (default: $KOTOHA_API_KEY)
  --help                 this text

The API key is never taken on the command line.
